title: REVISE: A Tool for Measuring and Mitigating Bias in Visual Datasets
benchmark_measurement: Over/under-representation of religious objects (e.g., mosque, church) in visual datasets, particularly within a geographic context.
findings: The tool found that in the YFCC100m dataset, the 'mosque' tag is overrepresented by 30x in images from Iran. This is used as an example to demonstrate the tool's capability to detect geographic-based representational biases for object classes, which can include religious items.
